description:
When a sudden fire forces Jae-Gyoung out of his shared living quarters, he's left scrambling for a place to stay-- all while struggling to stay afloat. Just as things seem to take a turn for the worse, Seong-Beom, a college classmate of Jae-Gyeong's, surprises him with a streak of generosity. He offers Jae-Gyeong a spare room in his apartment-- free of charge. But the two couldn't be more different, Jae-Gyeong is reserved, while Seong-Beom's outgoing nature seems to fill every room he enters. As they navigate the challenges of sharing a home, and a budding friendship, their clashing personalities ignite tension, possibly warming up to something more. Will their spark turn into a roaring flame or die out into embers?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited) 

*Note: Chapter count includes 8 side story chapters.*
